statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-33210 (GHSA-3m6g-2423-7cp3): from json 2.14.0, JSON.parse with the non-default allow_duplicate_key: false option passes part of the parsed document to a format string when it reports a duplicate key, which can crash the program or disclose memory. It is fixed in json 2.19.2 (and in 2.17.1.2 and 2.15.2.1 on older release lines) by commit https://github.com/ruby/json/commit/393b41c3e5, which changes ext/json/ext/parser/parser.c and is in v2.19.2 and not in v2.19.1. Release commit: https://github.com/ruby/json/commit/54f8a878aebee090476a53c851c943128894be62 and advisory: https://github.com/ruby/json/security/advisories/GHSA-3m6g-2423-7cp3. Downloaded every package built from the ruby-4.0 source in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository, 654 packages on x86_64 and aarch64, each checked against the repository index checksum: the interpreter packages ruby-4.0, ruby-4.0-libs, ruby-4.0-dev, ruby-4.0-doc, ruby-4.0-dbg and ruby-4.0-full, 4.0.1-r0, 4.0.1-r1, 4.0.2-r1, 4.0.2-r2, 4.0.3-r2, 4.0.4-r2, 4.0.4-r3, 4.0.5-r3, 4.0.6-r3, 4.0.6-r4, 4.0.7-r4, 4.0.9-r4, 4.0.10-r4 and the current 4.0.10-r5, and 40 gem packages (ruby4.0-abbrev to ruby4.0-typeprof), which are versioned separately from Ruby. Both architectures agree for every build. The json default gem, with its compiled parser.so and generator.so, ships in ruby-4.0-libs; no gem package contains a json library file (ruby4.0-rbs carries only a json.rbs type signature, and ruby-4.0-doc carries its documentation). ruby-4.0-libs 4.0.1-r0, 4.0.1-r1 and 4.0.2-r1 carry json 2.18.0, 4.0.2-r2 to 4.0.6-r3 carry json 2.19.2, and 4.0.6-r4 onward carry json 2.19.9. The debug symbols in the ruby-4.0-dbg package confirm the compiled parser: the json parser extension of 4.0.2-r2 and every later build has the build_parse_error_message function the fix adds, and those of 4.0.1-r0, 4.0.1-r1 and 4.0.2-r1 do not. The range has two spans because the gem packages carry their own versions and ruby4.0-bigdecimal is published as 4.0.1-r0 to 4.0.1-r5, which would otherwise sort between the vulnerable Ruby builds: introduced at the first build, 4.0.1-r0, fixed at 4.0.1-r2, then introduced at 4.0.2-r1 and fixed at 4.0.2-r2, the first build with the fixed json. This covers the vulnerable 4.0.1-r0, 4.0.1-r1 and 4.0.2-r1 builds and leaves out every gem package except ruby4.0-bigdecimal 4.0.1-r0 and 4.0.1-r1, which share their version with vulnerable Ruby builds and read as affected although they contain no json.
